lines.say: Before you lay it all down tonight, hear this.
lines.big: Before you lay it all down tonight

lines.say: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety. Psalm four, verse eight.
lines.big: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.

lines.say: You don't have to stand guard tonight. He does.
lines.big: You don't have to stand guard tonight.

lines.say: Lord, I give you tonight. Keep my house, and give me rest. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms one through thirty-one, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
lines.small: Psalms 1–31, read slowly. Link in the description.
